requirements.condition: when encoding or parsing an EndOfEarlyData handshake message
requirements.required_behavior: encode and accept an empty message body
requirements.forbidden_behavior: including fields or payload bytes in the EndOfEarlyData body
requirements.why_checkable: The handshake serializer and parser expose the exact body length.

requirements.quote:
If the server sent an "early_data" extension in EncryptedExtensions,
   the client MUST send an EndOfEarlyData message after receiving the
   server Finished.
requirements.condition: the server sent early_data in EncryptedExtensions
requirements.required_behavior: send EndOfEarlyData after receiving the server Finished message
requirements.forbidden_behavior: omitting EndOfEarlyData or sending it before receiving server Finished
requirements.why_checkable: A handshake trace can verify both presence and ordering of EndOfEarlyData.

requirements.quote:
If the server does not send an "early_data"
   extension in EncryptedExtensions, then the client MUST NOT send an
   EndOfEarlyData message.
requirements.condition: the server did not send early_data in EncryptedExtensions
requirements.why_checkable: The client flight can be checked against the negotiated early-data state.

requirements.required_behavior: transmit all 0-RTT application_data messages before EndOfEarlyData
requirements.why_checkable: Record ordering and traffic epochs are observable in a client trace.

requirements.quote:
This message indicates that all 0-RTT
   application_data messages, if any, have been transmitted and that the

requirements.required_behavior: protect following records with handshake traffic keys
requirements.forbidden_behavior: protecting following records with early-data traffic keys
requirements.why_checkable: The sender's selected traffic secret is visible at the record-protection boundary.

requirements.quote: Servers MUST NOT send this message
requirements.why_checkable: Server handshake emission paths can be inspected or traced.

requirements.quote:
clients receiving it MUST
   terminate the connection with an "unexpected_message" alert.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: continuing the connection after receiving EndOfEarlyData
requirements.why_checkable: Malformed peer-role input has an exact required alert and terminal outcome.

requirements.quote:
This
   message is encrypted under keys derived from the
   client_early_traffic_secret.
requirements.required_behavior: encrypt the message under keys derived from client_early_traffic_secret
requirements.forbidden_behavior: encrypting EndOfEarlyData under handshake or application traffic keys
requirements.why_checkable: The record layer's traffic-secret selection is concrete and testable.
